R6 class representing a dataset

Source: R/class_Dataset.R
Dataset.Rd

A dataset is used to store and access information about a set spatial layers.

Other functions for defining classes: Project, new_categorical_legend(), new_continuous_legend(), new_cost(), new_feature(), new_layer(), new_lock(), new_project(), new_provenance(), new_solution(), new_solution_legend(), new_theme(), new_tile()

Dataset$get_pu_status()

Identify which planning units would be associated with a zone depending on columns used to allocate them.

Usage

Dataset$get_pu_status(zone, allocation)

Arguments

zone

character value with name of zone.

allocation

Named character vector with column names indicating which planning units should be allocated to each zone. Note that the names of allocation indicate the zone names. Additionally, zones are allocated in order of decreasing priority. For example with allocation = c("Biodiversity" = "aspas", "Scientific" = "camps"), planning units are first assigned to the Scientific zone based on the values in the "camps" column, and then to the Biodiversity zone based on the values in the "aspas" column. If any planning unit was previously assigned to the Scientific zone, then it is overridden with the Biodiversity zone.

Returns

A numeric vector with binary values indicating if each planning unit is allocated to the zone.
